HSR 5-DoF wrist limit'.
re_measured_finding: Decomposing (affordance - origin) along the grasp's approach axis shows the raw euclidean distance is dominated by gripper depth-along-approach (selected top-25: median depth 0.115 m; raw 200: median depth 0.155 m), not perpendicular aiming error (selected top-25: median perpendicular offset 0.022 m, vs euclidean median 0.120 m).
what_changed: Metric redefined from a single euclidean origin-to-affordance distance into depth-along-approach + perpendicular-offset components; the 0.06 m threshold is recognised as unpassable by construction under the old metric (gripper origin sits ~one gripper-depth behind contact), and perpendicular offset is proposed as the convention-independent aiming measure.
